report_intro: This split is the second held-out split of the regulatory family (#750). It measures #735 and #736 cause 1. The profile is calibrated on the 5 calibration parts of bench/regulatory.

selection.rule: CFR parts with a fee, rate or charge heading, 2 to 150 sections that are not reserved, and section headings that name fees, rates, schedules, definitions or method steps. No part of bench/regulatory, no CFR part that a file under bench/ names, and no part in the cfr_references of the 462 Federal Register documents that bench/ names. One part for each agency where possible.
